brief: The canvas displays a complex, abstract environment composed entirely of glowing, interconnected lines. These luminous lines form intricate lattice structures that pulse with color—primarily shades of electric blue and neon green—representing multi-dimensional data grids. The structures appear to perpetually flow and shift, giving the viewer the impression of massive, underlying calculation. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, the structures briefly react, intensifying the glow and temporarily accelerating the flow in the vicinity of the click point, allowing the viewer to briefly observe how the data grids reorganize and refocus their patterns.
